subject: GTM: support & enablement staffing pulse — action items for QBR
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Ella Park <ella@catalysthealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: GTM: support & enablement staffing pulse — action items for QBR

Team — quick pulse before the QBR later this week. Attached is the latest staffing matrix (QBR_staffing_matrix_v3.xlsx) and the current support on-call roster. I want to surface gaps and lock owners so leadership has clear asks.

Topline concerns I want us to confirm by EOD PT:
- Support coverage: are the planned on-call shifts for week-of-launch staffed? (see Support_oncall_roster.pdf)
- Enablement: content readiness for four launch playbooks (sales, implementation, frontline support, partner onboarding) — status + author
- Pricing & docs: final pricing playbook updates and any outstanding legal/PO blockers with Catalyst Health

Please reply with three quick things: 1) one-line status for your area, 2) single blocker (if any), 3) owner and ETA to close. I’ll roll up for the QBR and include the concise ask for execs.

Links: GTMSUP-142 (prelaunch support runbook) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/GTMSUP-142
Drive: playbook drafts — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3CqbrPlaybook

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber

Jonas — quick status from Enablement: 2 of 4 playbooks are content-complete (sales + partner onboarding). Implementation and frontline support still in draft; I own frontline support doc and will get a completed draft to the drive by 2/16 COB.

Blocker: SME availability for implementation playbook — engineering SME (Priya) is booked through 2/17. If we need full review earlier, suggest we run a focused 60-minute review session with the SMEs on 2/16.

Owner/ETA: Laura (enablement) — frontline support draft in Drive by 2027-02-16T18:00:00-08:00. Implementation SME sync request flagged to karthik to advise.

Attachment: enablement_checklist_v2.pdf (see drive link)

—Laura

Thanks Jonas — pricing/docs update from Product & Pricing:
- Pricing playbook: draft v1.4 is uploaded; outstanding items are promo terms for enterprise pilot and final legal redlines on the SOW pricing appendix.
- Docs: API usage section needs a short example for Catalyst’s expected throughput (Ella flagged this).

Blocker: Legal still needs to clear PO/terms for Catalyst — karthik can you confirm status with Legal? If legal clearance takes longer than a week, we need to propose temporary guarded pricing for the pilot that doesn’t require SOW revision.

Owner/ETA: Marissa — finalize v1.4 and send to Legal by 2027-02-15T12:00:00-08:00.

Date: 2027-02-14T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GTM: support & enablement staffing pulse — action items for QBR

Appreciate the heads-up, Jonas. Catalyst is on an accelerated procurement track but Procurement (procure@catalysthealth.com) needs the SLA summary and on-call escalation matrix to complete approvals. Can you confirm whether the current support SLA in the playbook includes 24/7 incident paging for Sev1? Our team expects a short SLA addendum for the pilot period.

Also: we’d like a 30-minute walkthrough of the frontline support playbook next week (preferably 2/17 or 2/18 morning PT). Please confirm availability so we can lock calendar and procurement can finalize payment terms.

Thanks — Ella
Ella Park
Sr. Program Manager | Catalyst Health
ella@catalysthealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Summary and owners (final for QBR):
- Enablement: Laura to deliver frontline support draft by 2/16 COB and run 60-minute SME review on 2/16 10:00 PT (karthik to confirm Priya’s slot).
- Pricing/Docs: Marissa to push pricing playbook v1.4 to Legal by 2/15 noon; if Legal cannot clear the SOW appendix, we’ll propose a guarded pilot pricing (Marissa).
- Support SLA: Vivek to confirm current SLA covers 24/7 paging for Sev1 incidents or provide a short addendum draft by 2/16 17:00 PT. Attachments: Support_oncall_roster.pdf (current on-call coverage).
- External ask: Jonas to schedule 30-minute walkthrough for Catalyst on 2/17 09:30 PT pending Laura’s draft — calendar tentative until confirmation.

Next steps: everyone — please update the staffing matrix with any FTE changes and add the single blocker line. I’ll incorporate these into the QBR slide (3 bullets per function) and circulate by 2/15 09:00 PT.

Thanks all — tight timeline but we can get this done.

Jonas Weber
